name: Diablo

abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Detonate: Süresi dolduğunda veya Nullify edildiğinde enerji hasarı patlaması verir.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Diablo's alchemical self-experimentation grants the following:
+[687.5] Energy Resistance.
Incoming Poison effects suffer -100% Potency.
Basic Attacks deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.

abilitySections.title: Master Alchemist - Pre-Fight Ability
content: In the Pre-Fight Menu, Diablo can add up to 3 Alchemical Ingredients to his Philosopher's Mix Passive for the fight. He has unlimited Ingredients but can only add 1 of each type to a fight.
For each Ingredient type not used, gain 2 indefinite Vial of Might, granting +[569.04] Attack Rating & +10% Poison Potency. Max Stacks: 8.

abilitySections.title: Philosopher's Mix - Launch a Special Attack
content: Philosopher's Mix lasts 8 seconds per level of Special Attack used and heals Diablo [491.48] health every second. It also gains effects based on which Ingredients were added in the Pre-Fight Menu.
Distilled Will: Incoming Energy Damage causes Diablo to Passively Heal 70% of the damage taken.
Essence of Null: Every 2 seconds, 100% chance to Nullify 1 Buff on the opponent.
Grain of Uru: Gain Immunity to Stun effects & Armor Break Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: Personal Poison Debuffs - Max Stacks: 20
content: Unless otherwise stated, Diablo's Poison Debuffs inflict [6,449.12] direct damage over 14 seconds and reduce healing effects by 30%.
Heavy Attack: Each hit has 100% chance to inflict a Poison Debuff.
Medium Attack 2: 75% chance to inflict a Poison Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: After the attack, Diablo will drink from his flask. If he drinks for 1.5 seconds, he gains a Regeneration Passive, recovering [8,600.9] Health over 4 seconds. If his drink is interrupted, he gains a Vial of Might and Pauses all Poison effects on the opponent for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: First hit Reapplies all personal Poison effects on the opponent.
This attack is Unblockable and deals a burst of [4,742] Energy Damage. This burst of damage increases by +20% for each Buff & Poison that the opponent has gained this fight. Max Bonus: +500%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This attack can only be used once per fight.
This attack gains +[4,742] Attack rating. It also gains effects based on which Alchemical Ingredients have been added to the Flask.
Distilled Will: Gain a Regeneration Passive, healing [12,287] Health over 4 seconds.
Essence of Null: Places 10 Detonate Buffs on the opponent, which last 20 seconds and deal a burst of [1,896.8] Energy Damage when they expire or are Nullified.
Grain of Uru: Philosopher's Mix is Paused for 10 seconds.
For each Vial of Might: 100% chance to inflict 2 Poison Debuff(s).
